g.title: star_seed_acquisition
g.text: Closed-loop automatic acquisition of six star-shaped seed poses
One stationary reference + five adaptive rotation branches (before NBV)

g.title: start
g.text: Manual intervention is confined to initial alignment

g.title: manual
g.text: Move the target-surface chord into the guide ROI
and close to the desired 80-mm reference line

g.title: detect
g.text: ROI breakpoint detection and ordered assignment

g.title: refok
g.text: Safe pair, synchronized pose, sufficient inliers

g.title: track
g.text: Store the last verified safe pose

g.title: preflight_note
g.text: Measured ±X/±Y preflight is optional; this run used mode=off and skipped it.

g.title: return
g.text: Reset branch angle, step and feed-forward model

g.title: rotate
g.text: Start at Δθ=1°; accelerate to 2° after verification

g.title: measure
g.text: L is the intended physical-breakpoint separation

g.title: hard
g.text: Intended edge pair inside hard guard?

g.title: rollback
g.text: Rollback to last valid pose; reduce Δθ
Repeated failure: reference recovery / fallback branch

g.title: reject
g.text: Return to reference and try a fallback branch
A safe partial orientation may be retained as fallback

g.title: soft
g.text: Dual feature inside servo target band?

g.title: servo
g.text: Accepted measured motions update J by Broyden

g.title: accept
g.text: Store T_BF, surface profile and endpoints per inlier

g.title: save
g.text: This run: 6 physical poses, 98 synchronized inliers

g.title: evidence
g.text: Evidence from the selected real run
Observed order: reference → R_y(+) → R_y(-) → R_x(+) → R_x(-) → R_xR_y(+)
